The actor purchased the 3.4-acre waterfront estate along Jupiter Island's Intracoastal Waterway for USD 700,000. Over the years, he expanded the estate into a 12,538-square-foot compound.According to Jupiter Magazine, some of the amenities that were included in the late actorâs home included a 20-seat private screening room/movie theater, a billiard room, and expansive lounge areas, as well as a resort-style swimming pool that overlooked the Intracoastal Waterway.
